schema.title: Digital Game Maturity Model (DGMM)
schema.description: An assessment of one game development process activity on the DGMM maturity scale.

Perspective.description: Three perspectives: developers, consumer and business.

ProcessActivity.description: The game development process activities (GDPAs), key factors from three perspectives.

MaturityLevel.description: The proposed maturity scale includes five levels (in ascending order): Ad-Hoc, Opportunistic, Consistent, Organized, and Optimized.
